description: If the continuum is at least aleph omega, aleph omega to the aleph zero equals the continuum. If every smaller cardinal to the aleph one is below aleph omega, aleph omega to the aleph one equals aleph omega to the aleph zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ContinuumFunction.reduction_examples.{u} :
  (Cardinal.aleph Ordinal.omega0 ≤ 2 ^ Cardinal.aleph0 →
      Cardinal.aleph Ordinal.omega0 ^ Cardinal.aleph0 = 2 ^ Cardinal.aleph0) ∧
    ((∀ μ < Cardinal.aleph Ordinal.omega0, μ ^ Cardinal.aleph 1 < Cardinal.aleph Ordinal.omega0) →
      Cardinal.aleph Ordinal.omega0 ^ Cardinal.aleph 1 = Cardinal.aleph Ordinal.omega0 ^ Cardinal.aleph0)
